description: A PR, branch or diff review routes to code-review-and-quality while a staged-changes review stays with pre-commit-review; a design exploration routes to brainstorming and a spec-only request to spec-driven-development, ahead of the bare review/add/new keywords lower in the table.

cases.prompt: review my staged changes before commit
how should we add idempotency keys to payouts?
write a spec for a new export endpoint

expected.rationale: The code-review, brainstorming and spec rows sit above pre-commit-review, fix and implement, so first-match-wins precedence keeps the bare review/check/commit and add/new keywords from taking a PR review, a design question or a spec-only request, while a staged-changes review still reaches pre-commit-review.
